hook: Pick a real city, a real starting job and a place to live, then survive twelve months on your own: paychecks under 2026 tax rules, surprise bills, roommates, a credit card and a year-end report card. Class codes give everyone the same year.
outcome: Build and live on a monthly budget; read a paycheck; weigh needs and wants, housing costs and transportation; use savings, insurance and credit wisely when surprises hit
sources: Rents: HUD Fair Market Rents, FY2026
Starting pay: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, May 2025 (25th percentile by metro area)
Federal income tax: IRS Rev. Proc. 2025-32 (2026 brackets and standard deduction)
Food: USDA Food Plans: Cost of Food at Home (2025)
Health premiums: KFF 2025 Employer Health Benefits Survey
Credit card rates: Federal Reserve G.19 Consumer Credit (2026)
Illustrations generated with Google Gemini, edited for Curio Class
